sentences.en: Nitrous oxide stopped being used as an anaesthetic a long time ago.
sentences.zh: 一氧化二氮很久以前就不再用作麻醉剂了。

sentences.en: Nitrous oxide is inert at room temperature.
sentences.zh: 一氧化二氮在常温下是惰性的。

sentences.en: What made the comedian's audience laugh so uncontrollably that night was a convenient nitrous oxide leak.
sentences.zh: 让那个喜剧演员的观众那天晚上笑得如此无法控制的原因是一次偶然的一氧化二氮泄漏。

phrases.zh: 一氧化二氮：指的是笑气，一种能让人发笑的气体。
